\[
\liminf_{i\to\infty}
\left[\lambda_{h_i}^{s}(W_i)+\lambda_{h_i}^{s}(R_i)-\lambda_{g_i}^{s}(R_i)\right]
\ge (1-2^{-k})I,\qquad s=+,-.
\]
Here \(I\) is the fixed-type positive energy infimum. Thus at positive \(I\) and \(k>0\), a late positive endpoint cannot have both zero trim charge and unchanged exterior charge in either sign. When a constant Gram metric matches the whole trim, an attained positive endpoint saves exactly the original disk charge, bounded above by the finite excess \(E_+(g)-I\).
